items.headline: Kucherov scores three as Lightning rout Sabres 8-3
items.summary: Nikita Kucherov had three goals and an assist on five shots in Tampa Bay's 8-3 win in Buffalo on Wednesday. Both teams play again tonight.

items.headline: Commanders visit Giants on Thursday night
items.summary: Washington has ruled out Lucas Patrick (concussion) and Colson Yankoff (knee). New York's J.J. McCarthy was a full participant and carries no injury designation.

items.headline: Ullmark returns in goal for Senators against Avalanche
items.summary: Linus Ullmark is set to start Thursday after missing nine games with a lower-body strain. Nick Cousins is out 7 to 10 days after a hit on Tuesday.

items.headline: Lightning put Brayden Point on injured reserve
items.summary: Point (lower body) misses Thursday's game at Columbus, with a timetable update expected after Saturday. Defenceman Erik Cernak is probably out after a collision with the glass.

items.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs to have surgery on broken finger
items.summary: Jacobs will miss Sunday's game against Minnesota after surgery on a broken ring finger. Micah Parsons is expected to take part in 11-on-11 drills this week.

items.headline: Mammoth place Dylan Guenther on injured reserve
items.summary: Guenther (upper body) is expected to miss two to four weeks, and Logan Cooley is day to day. Kailer Yamamoto was activated from IR.

items.headline: Deshaun Watson cleared to start for Browns against Texans
items.summary: Watson will start Sunday after clearing concussion protocol. Houston's David Montgomery missed practice with a groin injury.

items.headline: Rams expect to be without Puka Nacua for a significant stretch
items.summary: Nacua will not go on injured reserve but is expected to miss significant time. Matthew Stafford was a full participant, and Davante Adams could return after Week 12.

items.headline: Kevin Fiala set for season debut with Kings
items.summary: Fiala is expected to play against the Islanders on Thursday after recovering from leg fractures sustained at the Winter Olympics.

items.headline: Cardinals to start rookie Carson Beck against Rams
items.summary: The 2026 third-round pick will make his first NFL start Sunday for 3-6 Arizona. Seattle has ruled out Sam Darnold for its game against the Raiders.

items.headline: Kaprizov wins it in overtime as Wild edge Canadiens 2-1
items.summary: Kirill Kaprizov scored on a 4-on-3 power play 21 seconds into overtime, extending both his and Minnesota's point streaks to nine games. Montreal's own point streak reached 11 games.

items.headline: Vikings acquire Kirk Cousins from the Raiders at the deadline
items.summary: Minnesota sent a 2027 third-round pick to Las Vegas for the veteran quarterback, one of the biggest moves before Tuesday's 4 p.m. ET deadline.

items.headline: McDavid chases a 20th straight game with a point to open the season
items.summary: Connor McDavid has 48 points and has scored in every game as Edmonton hosts Philadelphia; Leon Draisaitl brings a four-game goal streak.

items.headline: Colts deal Keenan Allen to the 49ers and Josh Downs to the Chiefs
items.summary: Indianapolis (2-7) moved two receivers at the deadline, getting a 2027 sixth from San Francisco for Allen and 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks from Kansas City for Downs.

items.headline: Gauthier seeks seventh straight game with a goal as Ducks host Predators
items.summary: Anaheim has won five in a row and Nashville five straight; the Predators play the second night of a back-to-back after blanking Los Angeles.

items.headline: Dolphins put Malik Willis on IR; Kyle McCord in line for first start
items.summary: Willis will miss at least four games with a groin injury, and McCord is expected to start Sunday against the Colts. Miami also placed Zach Sieler on IR ahead of season-ending biceps surgery.

items.headline: Barkov and Marchand back on the ice, could return within two weeks
items.summary: Both Panthers stars skated with the team for the first time since their injuries, per coach Paul Maurice. The Kings also expect Kevin Fiala to debut soon.

items.headline: Bills add safety Amani Hooker; Broncos land LB Daiyan Henley
items.summary: Buffalo (7-1) gave Tennessee a 2027 second-round pick for Hooker and a fifth, while Denver sent fourth- and fifth-round picks to the Chargers for Henley.

items.headline: Mark Stone two points from Vegas franchise scoring record
items.summary: Stone can pass Jonathan Marchessault as the Golden Knights host Utah, whose power play ranks second in the league at 37.1%.

items.headline: 49ers acquire receiver Keenan Allen from the Colts
items.summary: San Francisco sends a 2027 sixth-round pick to Indianapolis for the veteran wideout, shoring up an injury-hit receiver room ahead of Tuesday's 4 p.m. ET deadline.

items.headline: Bills beat Vikings 23-6 on Monday Night Football
items.summary: Buffalo led 10-6 midway through the third quarter and pulled away in a matchup of one-loss teams; Minnesota falls to 6-2.

items.headline: McDavid extends season-opening point streak to 19 as Oilers beat Rangers 3-1
items.summary: McDavid scored in the first period and Draisaitl added two, the second a short-handed empty-netter; Devon Levi made 29 saves.

items.headline: Vikings expected to trade for a quarterback before the deadline
items.summary: A source told Pro Football Talk that Minnesota will add a QB Tuesday, with Daniel Jones, Geno Smith, Mac Jones and Kirk Cousins among the names mentioned.

items.headline: Barkov and Marchand skate with Panthers for the first time since injuries
items.summary: Both took part in Tuesday's morning skate in Columbus; Paul Maurice said they are within about two weeks of returning. Neither plays tonight.

items.headline: Sharks end five-game skid with eight-round shootout win over Islanders
items.summary: Ivar Stenberg scored in regulation and won it in the shootout as San Jose beat New York 3-2.

items.headline: Flyers hold off Canucks 3-1 behind Woll
items.summary: Michael Bunting scored his first goal as a Flyer and Travis Konecny added a power-play goal on the second night of a back-to-back.

items.headline: Dolphins DT Zach Sieler out for the season with torn biceps
items.summary: Sieler was hurt in Sunday's loss to Detroit and will have surgery with a five-to-six-month recovery.

items.headline: Ullmark to miss a ninth straight game; Ersson starts vs. Washington
items.summary: Ottawa wants to give its No. 1 goalie a few more days and recalled Jackson Parsons from Belleville to back up.

items.headline: Rangers rookie defenceman Alberts Smits out week to week
items.summary: Smits has an upper-body injury and is listed week to week, per Monday's NHL status report.

items.headline: Jaguars acquire safety Jessie Bates III from Falcons
items.summary: Jacksonville sends a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick to Atlanta for the All-Pro safety ahead of the trade deadline.

items.headline: Gauthier hat trick powers Ducks past Penguins 5-2
items.summary: Cutter Gauthier scored three times at Honda Center on Sunday; Kris Letang and Rickard Rakell scored for Pittsburgh.

items.headline: Brayden Point left Sunday's game and "might miss some time"
items.summary: The Lightning forward exited in the first period at Winnipeg with an undisclosed injury, per coach Jon Cooper.

items.headline: Sam Darnold ruled out for Week 10; Drew Lock expected to start for Seattle
items.summary: Seattle coach Mike Macdonald said Darnold (quad, ribs) will miss the game, and tests on Lock's oblique came back good.

items.headline: Hellebuyck earns first Devils shutout in 4-0 win over Toronto
items.summary: Connor Hellebuyck made 23 saves at Scotiabank Arena on Sunday and Timo Meier scored twice.

items.headline: Puka Nacua undergoing MRI on knee
items.summary: The Rams receiver's injury is not believed to be season-ending, but he could miss games.

items.headline: Flames defenceman Kevin Bahl needs season-ending Achilles surgery
items.summary: Bahl ruptured the tendon during an off-ice warmup and has been placed on injured reserve.

items.headline: Giants expect J.J. McCarthy back Thursday against Washington
items.summary: McCarthy is recovering from a hip pointer, and running back Cam Skattebo should also be ready, per NFL.com's Monday roundup.

items.headline: Lekkerimaki moves to Vancouver's top line for Flyers visit
items.summary: Jonathan Lekkerimaki skated with Elias Pettersson and Brock Boeser on Monday, and Leevi Merilainen is expected to start against Joseph Woll and the Flyers, who are on a back-to-back.

items.headline: Cale Makar leaves practice as a precaution, expected for road trip
items.summary: Colorado's star defenceman was to be re-evaluated Monday and is expected to join the team for a trip that starts Tuesday.

items.headline: Mahomes takes hit to throwing elbow against the Jets, returns before halftime
items.summary: Patrick Mahomes threw on the sideline after a hard hit to his right elbow and came back to lead Kansas City 14-12 at the half. Andy Reid said the elbow was sore.

items.headline: Kucherov ends it in OT as Lightning rally past Wild 4-3
items.summary: Tampa Bay erased a two-goal third-period deficit; Nikita Kucherov won it on the power play at 3:23 of overtime and Jake Guentzel had two goals and an assist.

items.headline: McDavid stretches season-opening streak to 18 as Oilers beat Canucks
items.summary: Connor McDavid had three assists and Leon Draisaitl scored twice in a 4-2 win; Vancouver fell to 3-15-1. Ryan Nugent-Hopkins left after a puck hit him in the head.

items.headline: Rielly hurt as Canadiens beat Leafs, run point streak to 10
items.summary: Morgan Rielly left with a lower-body injury and didn't return in Montreal's 4-2 win; his status for Sunday against New Jersey was unresolved. Stolarz is expected in goal.

items.headline: Mike Evans out for 49ers; Myles Garrett back for Rams
items.summary: Evans will miss Sunday's game against the Raiders with Achilles tendinitis, while Garrett returns from knee surgery. Seattle's Quenton Nelson will miss time after knee surgery.

items.headline: Hurricanes score nine to tie franchise record in rout of Blackhawks
items.source: Field Level Media via Southern Sports Today
items.summary: Carolina beat Chicago 9-2 before leaving for its Global Series games in Finland; Jordan Martinook and Andrei Svechnikov each scored twice.

items.headline: Friedman: Kucherov's trade request is no negotiating tactic
items.summary: Elliotte Friedman reports people close to Kucherov believe he is serious about not returning to Tampa after this season; GM Julien BriseBois hasn't publicly responded.

items.headline: Watson expected inactive; Egbuka will play, St. Brown expected to
items.summary: Deshaun Watson is expected to be inactive for Cleveland despite clearing concussion protocol. Kyle Monangai and Jaylen Wright won't play Sunday.

items.headline: Devils bring four-game win streak to Toronto
items.summary: New Jersey has won eight of nine after Jack Hughes's overtime winner against the Islanders; both teams are on the second night of a back-to-back.

items.headline: Backups in focus across Week 9: Lock, Milton, Sanders and Minshew start
items.summary: Drew Lock, Joe Milton III, Shedeur Sanders and Gardner Minshew are all starting Sunday; Pittsburgh and Tennessee are on bye.

items.headline: McDavid takes 17-game point streak into Saturday's game against Vancouver
items.summary: A point against the 3-14-1 Canucks would give Connor McDavid the longest active-player run, passing his own 2021-22 streak and William Nylander's 2023-24 mark. Edmonton has lost two straight.

items.headline: Kaprizov's four points lead Wild past Sharks 4-1
items.summary: Kirill Kaprizov had a goal and three assists and Quinn Hughes added a goal and two assists as Jesper Wallstedt stopped all but one shot.

items.headline: Shedeur Sanders to start for Browns as Watson stays questionable
items.summary: Coach Todd Monken named Sanders the starter for Sunday against New Orleans; Deshaun Watson has cleared the concussion protocol but remains questionable.

items.headline: Hyman and Levi return for Oilers against Canucks
items.summary: Zach Hyman is back after missing five games with a neck injury, and Devon Levi will start in goal after missing seven games.

items.headline: Ravens acquire QB Jacoby Brissett from Cardinals
items.summary: Arizona sends Brissett and a 2027 fifth-round pick to Baltimore for a 2027 fourth-rounder and a 2028 seventh-rounder.

items.headline: Ducks score four unanswered to beat Flames 5-3
items.summary: Leo Carlsson tied it on a third-period power play and Cutter Gauthier scored the winner with 1:34 left after Anaheim trailed 3-1.

items.headline: Rams activate Myles Garrett from injured reserve
items.summary: Garrett is in line to return Sunday from a knee injury; cornerback Jaylen Watson went on IR with a shoulder injury.

items.headline: Heiskanen to miss second straight game for Stars
items.summary: Miro Heiskanen, hurt on a hit into the boards, is not expected to play Saturday against San Jose, per coach Glen Gulutzan.

items.headline: Seahawks rule out QB Sam Darnold against Arizona
items.summary: Darnold (quad/ribs) is out Sunday, along with receiver Rashid Shaheed and tackle Charles Cross.

items.headline: Cooley's hot streak meets Senators as Ullmark eyes return
items.summary: Logan Cooley has two hat tricks in his last four games for Utah, while Ottawa's Linus Ullmark (7-1-0, .945) could return from a lower-body strain.

items.headline: Ducks hold off Oilers 5-4 despite four points from McDavid
items.summary: Beckett Sennecke and Pavel Mintyukov each had two goals and an assist, and Cutter Gauthier scored for the ninth time in four games. McDavid's goal and three assists stretched his season-opening point streak to 17 games.

items.headline: Jaguars rout Ravens 33-10 on Thursday night
items.summary: Rookie Joe Fagnano, making his first start, went 10 of 18 for 60 yards with two interceptions as Baltimore lost its fourth straight and fell to 4-5. Jacksonville is 6-2; Lamar Jackson was placed on injured reserve.

items.headline: Caufield wins it 30 seconds into OT after Cooley hat trick
items.summary: Logan Cooley scored three goals for Utah, his second hat trick in four games, but Montreal rallied for a 5-4 overtime win. Nick Suzuki had a goal and two assists in his return from a six-game absence.

items.headline: Kyler Murray out Monday; Wentz to start for Vikings against Bills
items.summary: Kevin O'Connell said Murray's hamstring injury will keep him out, with Carson Wentz starting. The 49ers say Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel are unlikely to play Sunday against the Raiders.

items.headline: Stamkos's overtime power-play goal sinks Avalanche
items.summary: Steven Stamkos scored 2:18 into overtime for a 3-2 Nashville win, his 247th career power-play goal, tying Luc Robitaille for fifth all time. Justus Annunen made 30 saves for the Predators' third straight win.

items.headline: Tavares expected back Saturday; Kulich and Timmins return for Sabres
items.summary: John Tavares practiced fully and is set to return against Montreal after missing nine games. Buffalo gets Jiri Kulich (concussion) and Conor Timmins (season debut) back Friday against Columbus.

items.headline: Heiskanen doubtful for Saturday; Ullmark being reevaluated
items.summary: Dallas defenceman Miro Heiskanen sat out Thursday and is doubtful against San Jose. Ottawa's Linus Ullmark has missed seven games with a lower-body strain.

items.headline: Red-hot Gauthier and the Ducks visit Calgary on a back-to-back
items.summary: Anaheim skipped the morning skate after winning in Edmonton; Lukas Dostal and Dustin Wolf are the projected starters. Calgary activated goalie Devin Cooley from injured reserve.

items.headline: Mayfield practices fully for Buccaneers
items.summary: Baker Mayfield (right thumb) was a full participant, and Emeka Egbuka (knee) and Kenneth Gainwell (hip) were upgraded to full practice.

fantasyWeeks.method: For each defence I took points allowed per game to each position from FFToolbox's 2026 points-allowed tables (raw passing, rushing and receiving lines through Week 9), rescored them in PPR (0.04/pass yd, 4/pass TD, −2/INT, 0.1/yd, 6/TD, 1/rec), divided by the 32-team average and shrank toward 1.00 with weight G/(G+5). RBs use FantasyTools' half-PPR RB points allowed (through Week 9) because no PPR RB table could be retrieved. Play-caller factor O comes from this morning's NFL sheet where it gave one (WAS WR 1.08, NYG WR 0.98, NYG TE 1.14, WAS TE 0.87); all other teams use O = 1.00. Combined idx = D × √O clamped to 0.80–1.25; projection = season PPR/g (RosterAudit 2026) × idx. D/ST = 0.4×(sacks/g ÷ 2.6) + 0.3×(INT/g ÷ 0.75) + 0.3×(league pts/g ÷ opponent pts/g), from NFL.com sacks and interceptions and ESPN points for, shrunk the same way.
fantasyWeeks.notes: Allen at the Jets (26.9), Walker at Atlanta (26.7) and Smith-Njigba at Las Vegas (27.0) lead their positions; Maye and St. Brown get the week's biggest lift from Detroit and New England's soft QB and WR numbers, and Likely tops the TEs once the Giants' TE target share is counted. Love, Cousins, Watson and Golden draw Minnesota's league-low QB and WR allowance, and Burrow, McBride and Bowers face bottom-eight defences at their positions. Five offences start QBs the season averages don't capture (BAL, SEA, MIN, NYG, ARI), so treat Flowers, Smith-Njigba, Jefferson, Nabers, Likely and McBride as rougher than their numbers look.

fantasyWeeks.method: For each defence I took PPR points allowed per game to each position (StatPro's 2026 defence-vs-position table, scored 0.04/pass yd, 4/pass TD, −2/INT, 0.1/yd, 6/TD, 1/rec), divided by the 32-team average and shrank toward 1.00 with weight G/(G+5), using games played from NFL.com standings. Play-caller factor O comes from this morning's TNF sheet for Carolina (pass 1.05, run 0.93) and Green Bay (pass 1.04); every other team uses O = 1.00. Combined idx = D × √O clamped to 0.80–1.25; projection = season PPR/g (RosterAudit 2026) × idx. D/ST = 0.4×(sacks/g ÷ 2.6) + 0.3×(INT/g ÷ 0.75) + 0.3×(league pts/g ÷ opponent pts/g) from NFL.com team stats, shrunk the same way.

fantasyWeeks.label: Week 6
fantasyWeeks.method: For each defense I computed PPR points allowed per game to each position from season box-score totals (QB: 0.04/pass yd, 4/pass TD, −2/INT, 0.1/rush yd, 6/rush TD). Dividing by the league average gives a matchup factor. With only five games per team, I shrink each factor halfway toward 1.00, then multiply it by the player's season PPR average to project this week.
fantasyWeeks.notes: Matchup factor 1.20 means the defense has allowed about 20% more than average after shrinking for sample size. Lamar Jackson is out (Tyler Huntley starts), so he is off the QB list; Hurts and Mayfield are also out, which lowers the Eagles' and Buccaneers' passing games without changing their opponents' matchup grades. Re-check inactives about 90 minutes before kickoff.
